newsitem.title: FRANCE: AI(R) group signs $100 mln of aircraft sales.
newsitem.headline: AI(R) group signs $100 mln of aircraft sales.

text.p: The aircraft marketing consortium Aero International (Regional) AI(R) said on Tuesday that it had signed sales contracts for six planes totalling around $100 million.

AI(R) said in a statement it sold four ATR 72-200 and one ATR 42-300 of the ATR turboprop range and an RJ 100 jet. The consortium comprises Aerospatiale of France, British Aerospace Plc and Alenia of Italy's Finmeccanica.

Three of the ATR 72-200s were sold to Binter Canarias, a unit of Spain's Iberia. Cityflyer Express, based at Britain's London Gatwick airport, bought the fourth ATR 72-200, as well as the RJ 100 jet. Transportes Aereas de Cabo Verde (TACV) of Africa bought the ATR 42-300.
AI(R), based in Toulouse, southwest France, has sold 26 new ATRs since the beginning of 1997, exceeding the total 25 sales announced for the whole of 1996, a spokesman said.
AI(R) has total orders to date for 535 ATRs, of which 331 are for the ATR 42 and 204 for the larger ATR 72, and 110 orders for the Avro RJ, it said.
